content_sections.heading: CCI CCR Kiln Operator on FTC Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CCI CCR Kiln Operator on FTC Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the CCI recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Cement Corporation of India (CCI) recruitment is CCR Kiln Operator on FTC.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the CCR Kiln Operator on FTC post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate/Diploma with a minimum of 02 years of experience in plant kiln operations in any reputed Cement Industry.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 54 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the post?
faq.answer: The salary for the post is negotiable.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Tandur, Telangana, with the pincode 501158.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.
